preamble.summary: 2 Samuel 22 contains David's psalm of deliverance — paralleled at Psalm 18 with significant textual differences. 4QSamᵃ preserves portions; the parallel-vs-Samuel question is illuminated by DSS readings showing the Samuel text-form is generally more conservative than the Psalm 18 text-form.
preamble.notable_variants: Variants align with the textual differences between Samuel-22 and Psalm-18, illuminating the textual relationship between the two parallel poems.
